description: Repair a JSON value toward a schema using only the coercions the caller declares — Validates a JSON value against a caller-supplied JSON Schema 2020-12 and applies only the coercions you list (for example string-to-integer for "42", trim-strings, enum-case, apply-defaults, drop-additional) when each one strictly reduces the number of schema errors. Every change is returned with its JSON pointer, the rule, the old and new value; every error that remains is returned with its exact

coercions.description: Coercions you allow. Empty means validate only.

schema.description: The schema the value must satisfy. Full JSON Schema 2020-12 (local $ref only).

name: schema-repair
